form_mapping_note: GRA own records mapped to runtime index 07 from prior capture mapping; base records, not winning overrides.

candidate_damage_stage_pairs.rule: unique prehealth before next prehit, same session/source/target and 0..50 ms later; proximity only, not engine hit ID or damage application count

video_review.method: Six sampled frames only; no continuous playback or audio review. Metadata and images in video-frames.

observations.observation: Main menu console lists installed extender versions and existing JohnnyGuitar EDID warning.
Console reports NVOCombatCore 203 and packet 1 initialization. Mismatched-parenthesis output follows Nice :) entered in console, consistent with that console input being parsed.
Gun Runners scene and manual console commands visible.
Pip-Boy displays Tri-beam Laser Rifle selected/equipped and HP 590/590.
Live hostile Gun Runner Guard visible; blood overlay and player HUD.
Pip-Boy displays inventory including Super Sledge and Sleepytyme; Tire Iron highlighted, HP 437/590.

video_review.limits: Frames do not establish all shots, full reload ordering, VATS state or god-mode toggles. HP display changed across the sample but does not prove a per-hit damage delta. The log supplies post-reload hit evidence; video was not used to assign timestamps to individual log rows.

review_outcome: Accept 2B4 reload/body-hit/outgoing-melee and sampled multi-projectile observation checkpoint. Proceed only to passive BallistX data preparation. Damage authority, committed HP/application counting, all pellet paths, robots/NPC-to-NPC and tagged VATS remain later gates.
